title: Un-Doubling Diffusion: LLM-guided Disambiguation of Homonym Duplication

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a translation-first pipeline by translating unambiguous non-English (Russian) prompts into English and measuring the Wrong Sense Rate (WSR) and Homonym Duplication Rate (HDR) in the generated images to quantify unintended meanings.
Evaluating the frequency at which models generate a specific character or proper name (e.g., 'Batman' or 'Stitch') rather than the common noun meanings when prompted with a homonym.
